title: Grilled Plantain Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional Venezuelan empanadas, using grilled plantains as the main filling. A delicious and hearty snack or dessert.
instructions: 1. Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch rounds.
2. Grill the plantain slices over medium heat until they develop a nice char and are slightly tender.
4. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, cheese, eggs, salt, and pepper.
5. Mix the dough ingredients until a ball forms.
6. Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
7. Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle.
8. Place a few slices of grilled plantain in the center of each dough circle.
9. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
10. Brush the tops with vegetable oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
